import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}reminder-setup`;// Get Data
const getReminders=async access_token=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,config);return response.data;};// Create 
const createReminder=async(data,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,data,config);return response.data;};// update
const updateReminder=async(id,newData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+'/'+id,newData,config);return response.data;};// Delete 
const deleteReminder=async(id,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+'/'+id,config);return response.data;};const reminderSetupService={getReminders,createReminder,updateReminder,deleteReminder};export default reminderSetupService;
